summary: Phase 5b shipped (commit 85d6a51) — organizations and membership, the second slice of Mycelium Layer 3. The architecture decision the operator blessed: an organization is simply a wallet — its own keypair and identity, named for the collective — which needs zero new key architecture and keeps organizations genuinely sovereign. A membership is a credential-kind attestation (credential_type=membership) the organization's wallet signs about a person, carrying both parties' ids and names. The new MembershipModal runs a one-directional two-QR flow, lighter than the handshake: the recipient shows their identity, the organization scans it and signs the membership, shows it back, and the recipient scans it and holds + anchors it — only the organization signs, because only the organization is vouching. Held memberships list in a new Memberships section on the Identity tab. Nesting is free: an organization holds a membership in a larger organization exactly the way a person does, because an organization is also a wallet. No new tapit-attest kinds — it reuses credentialAttestation, QrShow/QrScanModal, and the cosigning parseEnvelope helper.

why.text: Operator: 'Cut away.' Phase 5b was operator-blessed: an organization is a wallet (forced by the architecture — createWallet/walletStore are one-wallet-per-login), and the operator connected it to the recovery vision the prior session wove into the spec. The build was grounded by re-reading createHandshake.ts and the connections manifest first.

uncertainty: Build-verified only. Issuing a membership is a two-QR exchange between two devices and cannot be exercised in CI or on a single phone. The org-as-a-wallet model is sound and minimal; the modal flow reads correctly but wants a two-device field test. A small open point for later: organization identities are not formally typed as person-vs-organization in 5b — an org is just a wallet with a collective's name; formal typing can come if needed.
next: Operator field-tests the handshake and membership flows with two devices. Phase 5c — Nostr transport (remote Tier R links and remote sync) — is the next Layer 3 increment. Recovery stays Phase 5e.
